tasks.title: Lint specs for uncheckable criteria before building
tasks.description: Warn before any money is spent when a task has nothing checkable in it. Add plugin/scripts/g2g-spec-lint.sh <spec.json>, heuristic and advisory. It reads criteria only through jq (criterion text is untrusted and never evaluated) and prints one line per warning, 'g2g-spec-lint: WARN <task-id>: <reason>', then a summary line 'g2g-spec-lint: <n> warning(s)'. Warnings: (a) a task none of whose acceptance criteria has a runnable or observable anchor: a backtick-quoted span, one of the spec's context.verificationCommands verbatim, a path-like token (contains '/' or ends in a file extension), or an outcome verb (exits, passes, fails, prints, outputs, returns, contains, lists, matches); (b) any criterion containing a vague phrase from a fixed list in the script (works correctly, as expected, properly, robust, clean, fast, efficient, intuitive, user-friendly, gracefully, appropriate), quoting the phrase; (c) a task with an empty acceptanceCriteria array. It exits 0 whether or not it warns, and 2 only when the file is missing or not JSON; it never blocks a build. Callers: plugin/commands/spec.md adds step 5a, which runs the lint after the evidence check, revises any warned criteria once, re-runs, and lists the remaining warnings in the report. build.md Phase 1 adds step 5a, which runs it and prints its output verbatim as a warning, never aborting; if the script cannot run, say so and continue, because it is advisory, unlike the evidence script. build-wf.md inherits Phase 1 by reference. g2g-evidence.sh is untouched. Document the lint in plugin/README.md and in writing-g2g-specs/SKILL.md's acceptance-criteria section. Owns the version bump for the whole spec: set plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json to 0.8.1 and add a matching CHANGELOG.md section in this task's commit; the other tasks append to it and never bump.

tasks.title: Export open findings to GitHub issues (opt-in, one-way)
tasks.description: Fixes F-013 (phase 1 of its suggestion; its phase 3, importing human-filed issues, stays out of scope). A one-way export: findings.json stays the source of truth, and selection never reads issue state. (1) Add plugin/scripts/g2g-issues.sh as the sole implementation: 'g2g-issues.sh export <findings.json>'. It reads finding text only from the JSON (jq) and writes titles and bodies to files in a 'mktemp -d' directory; nothing from a finding ever appears in command source (L-004). For each open finding (addressed null or absent) with severity != info, confidence != low, category != security, and no 'issue' field: first look for an existing issue (gh issue list --label g2g --state all --search '<id> in:title' --json number,title, matching the exact '[<id>] ' title prefix) and reuse its number, so a lost write-back never creates a duplicate; otherwise create one titled '[<id>] <title>', labeled g2g, whose body holds the description, file:line and suggestion plus a footer saying findings.json is authoritative and this issue is a one-way export. Ensure the label exists first (gh label create g2g --force). Write each issue number back to that finding's 'issue' field (jq to a temp file, then mv). For every finding whose addressed is 'stale-<date>' or 'rejected-<date>' and whose issue is still open, close it as not planned with a one-line comment giving the reason. Security findings are never exported, because a public issue discloses the vulnerability. Exit codes: 0 done; 2 usage error or missing/invalid findings file; 3 skipped because gh is missing or 'gh auth status' fails, findings file untouched; 4 partial, some gh calls failed and only the successful numbers were written back. Output: one line per action and a summary line. (2) Add an optional 'issue' (number|null) field to the findings schema table in plugin/skills/reviewing-codebase/SKILL.md; reviews preserve it exactly like addressed. (3) Add an optional "github": {"issueExport": false} block to every plugin/templates/*.json. (4) plugin/commands/review.md: after step 6's validation and before step 7, when github.issueExport is exactly true, run the script, report its output, re-run step 6's jq validation, and never fail the review on exit 3 or 4. Amend review.md's opening ('You change NOTHING except two artifacts') to name this opt-in export as its one outward-facing action. (5) plugin/commands/improve-cycle.md Phase I-1 runs review.md with the export step skipped: headless ticks never create or close issues, and the next standalone /g2g:review picks up their findings and stale marks. Append a bullet to the CHANGELOG 0.8.1 section; no version bump.

tasks.title: Close finding issues from improve PRs
tasks.description: Completes F-013's phase 2 (closing issues from fix PRs). In plugin/commands/improve-cycle.md Phase I-5, after step 1 marks findings addressed, and only when github.issueExport is exactly true: collect the 'issue' numbers of those findings (each must match ^[0-9]+$; skip anything else), write the PR's current body (gh pr view <pr> --json body --jq .body) plus one 'Closes #<n>' line per issue to a file in a 'mktemp -d' directory, and apply it with 'gh pr edit <pr> --body-file <file>'. This is a GitHub API call, not a commit: it adds no commit and no push. A gh failure is reported and never fails the cycle. GitHub closes the issues only when a human merges the PR; a PR closed unmerged leaves them open, which is why Phase I-2 step 1a's reopen needs no issue step. Document the linkage in docs/G2G_PLUGIN_REF.md section 2 (findings backlog) and plugin/README.md's Review & the improve flywheel section: one-way export, findings.json authoritative, headless ticks never create issues, security findings never exported. Append a bullet to the CHANGELOG 0.8.1 section; no version bump.
